review_notes: Segment 0: The transcript ends with a truncated fragment 'इस दोष का म' which appears to be cut off in the recording/ASR. No change was made due to uncertainty about intended continuation.

Segment 9: English code-switches ('His interaction level is sometimes more than anybody.', 'he has a tremendous sensitivity, to sense it.') were left as spoken. Confirm if any transliteration or translation is desired downstream.

Segment 10: The cluster 'उपरमते, उपराम' (seen in 'अंगानि उपसंहरते, उपरमते, उपराम कर लेता है') remains uncertain in exact wording/meaning; left as in cleaned text but please verify against original lecture or source Sanskrit if precise wording is required.

Segment 11: Left several code-switched English words (e.g., 'He is open to every risk', 'Otherwise', 'This is the law', 'initiation') unchanged as they appear intentional.

Segment 11: Did not alter phrases that are uncertain or could affect doctrinal meaning, such as 'विषयाः विनिवर्तन्ते', 'चित्त ... विद्ध', and 'पत्थर पढ़ने वाले हैं' — these may be ASR renderings or colloquial speech; please review if a canonical/speaker-verified rendering is required.
Segment 11: Sanskrit items like 'रसवर्जम्' and 'तस्य प्रज्ञा प्रतिष्ठिता' were preserved as spoken; no reconstruction from external sources was attempted.

Segment 12: Verify the quoted Sanskrit line 'इन्द्रियाणि प्रमाथीनि हरन्ति प्रसभं मनः।' — spelling and sandhi are uncertain in the ASR output and may require human review against the speaker's intended Sanskrit.
Segment 12: Confirm phrase 'संयम-हिंसा' — it appears in the transcript but could be an ASR rendering of a compound or two separate terms; review for doctrinal accuracy.

Segment 12: The spoken colloquial fragment 'परम दृष्ट्वा, जब परम को देखोगे ना,' was preserved as uttered; the formal Sanskrit quotation was rendered as 'परमदृष्ट्वा निवर्तते रसोऽपि।' — please review if a different sandhi/wording was intended.
